name: Notification service extension and mutable content
plain: A small helper that edits an iOS push for about 30 seconds before it is shown.
meaning: Lets a company decrypt message text, fetch images and personalize on the phone. Android does the same inside the messaging service; both give short windows to run code.

android.persistence: Data messages run onMessageReceived in a short window (about 10 s before the system may kill the work)
android.note: Must finish quickly or hand off to WorkManager; for v2 RemoteNotification a 20 s window

ios.permission: UNNotificationServiceExtension; aps mutable-content 1 with an alert
ios.persistence: Original content shown if the extension fails or time runs out
ios.store_policy: App Review: extension used only to improve notifications
ios.note: About 30 s to modify the payload; does not run for silent, sound-only or badge-only payloads or if alerts are disabled

limits.headline: Can edit an iPhone push for about 30 seconds before you see it
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when a push arrives and before the alert shows
can: Download a picture or attach media before the alert shows
Change the title or text, for example to decrypt a message
Add details quickly, or hand longer work to a background job on Android
cannot: Run for more than about 30 seconds
Run for silent, sound only or badge only pushes on iPhone
Run when alerts are off for the app
Work on Android with a long window; it must finish quickly
limits.reach_label: A short edit before the alert shows
limits.differs: iPhone has a service extension with about 30 seconds. Android must finish quickly or hand off to a background job.

story.what_it_is: A tiny helper that edits an iPhone alert for about 30 seconds before you see it.

marketing.name: Modifying content in newly delivered notifications
marketing.pitch: Apple lets apps change an alert on arrival, for example to decrypt text or attach a picture.

story.for_you: You see a finished alert, such as a message that was scrambled in transit and shown as readable text. You never see the helper work in that short window.
story.for_makers: Makers use it for end to end encrypted chats, previews and personal touches. The helper also runs code before display, so some use it to send a signal that the alert arrived.

use_cases.example: A secure chat app decrypts the message on your phone so the server never sees the text.
A courier app downloads a photo of your doorstep and attaches it to the alert.
A news app adds a thumbnail to the headline alert.
A social app swaps in the sender's current profile photo.
A marketing tool records that the alert reached the phone before you even saw it.
A bank app shows your balance in the alert after fetching it securely.
A game builds a personal alert like Your farm is ready, Sam.

risks: Can report that an alert arrived
Runs code before you see anything
story.android_note: Android does the same inside the messaging service with a short time window.
story.ios_note: About 30 seconds. It does not run for silent pushes or when alerts are off.

technical_bounds: iOS extension does not run for silent pushes

abuse: Beaconing from the extension before display
